title: [bundle] Fix audit-found nested command fail-open navigation gaps: `h
objective: Fix audit-found nested command fail-open navigation gaps: `hf hook list --definitely-unsupported-flag`, `hf delivery list --definitely-unsupported-flag`, and `hf policy check-edit --definitely-unsupported-flag` currently exit successfully instead of rejecting unsupported args. Make these nested/read-only command paths reject unsupported flags before doing work with clear command-specific diagnostics, while preserving documented supported forms (`hf hook list [--json]`, `hf hook run EVENT [--payload JSON] [--json]`, `hf delivery list [--json]`, `hf delivery get <correlation_id> [--json]`, and `hf policy check-* [--json]`). Add CLI regressions proving unsupported nested flags exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo, and keep help paths side-effect free.
acceptance_criteria: hf hook list, hf delivery list, and hf policy check-* reject unsupported flags before doing work.
Regression coverage proves unsupported nested flags exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo.
Supported nested forms remain valid: hook list/run, delivery get/list, and policy check-* with --json.
Documented help paths remain side-effect free.
